title: What is FinOps?
facebook_comment_text: Gracefully scaling to zero isn't just about turning things off; it's strategic. We're talking about serverless functions or de-provisioned containers that actually save you money, not just sit idle. 💡 What’s been your team's biggest hurdle in adopting true 'scale-to-zero' architectures: managing cold starts or ensuring seamless data consistency? 👇
